terms.Gruppenadresse: Logical address in the KNX system (format: Main/Middle/Sub)
terms.Hauptgruppe: Top hierarchy level of the GA structure (0-31)
terms.Untergruppe: Lowest level with the actual device address (0-255)
terms.Datenpunkttyp: Standardized data type for KNX communication objects (DPT/DPST)
terms.Linie: Smallest topological installation unit, max. 256 bus participants
terms.Bereich: Grouping of up to 15 lines via a main line
terms.Linienkoppler: Connects subordinate line with main line (address: A.L.0)
terms.Bereichskoppler: Connects main line with area line/backbone (address: A.0.0)
terms.Backbone: Connection of up to 15 areas (TP or IP)
terms.Gewerk: Functional area in the building (e.g. lighting, blinds, heating)
terms.Aktor: KNX device that executes switching commands (e.g. switch actuator, dimming actuator)
terms.Sensor: KNX device that captures operations (e.g. push button, presence detector)
terms.Rueckmeldung: Status feedback from an actuator to the bus
terms.Szene: Predefined combination of switching commands for multiple trades
terms.Zentraladresse: Cross-floor group address in main group 0
